basic_details.short_information: UCMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026: The University College of Medical Sciences (UCMS), University of Delhi, has released for direct recruitment to 54 Assistant Professor vacancies across 22 departments. The recruitment includes Anatomy, Biochemistry, Community Medicine, Emergency Medicine, Endocrinology, General Medicine, General Surgery, Pathology, Pharmacology, Dentistry and other medical specialties. Candidates possessing the prescribed MD, MS, DNB, DM, MDS, postgraduate or equivalent qualifications, along with the applicable teaching experience, can apply online.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026 - 54 Posts
content_sections.text: The recruitment covers 54 Assistant Professor positions in 22 departments , including medical, surgical, super-specialty and dental disciplines. Reservation Clarification: The vacancy table lists seven PwBD (Locomotor Disability) reserved positions separately. Applicants belonging to UR, SC, ST, OBC or EWS categories who also meet the notified PwBD eligibility may apply for these positions. The advertised total also includes backlog vacancies: one ST position in General Surgery, one OBC position in General Medicine and one OBC position in Pharmacology. Bio-Statistics Vacancy: The OBC vacancy shown under Community Medicine is specifically advertised for Bio-Statistics and carries Academic Pay Level 10 instead of the standard Assistant Professor Pay Level 11.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Notification and Corrigendum
content_sections.text: The University College of Medical Sciences, University of Delhi, has released the following documents for this recruitment: Original Notification: , containing the 54 department-wise vacancies, qualification and experience requirements, application fees, age limit, pay scale and general instructions. Corrigendum: Extended Notification PDF Dated 13 November 2026 , extending the online application deadline to 28 November 2026 or two weeks from Employment News publication, whichever is later. Both documents should be read together. The corrigendum modifies only the application closing date.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a recognized postgraduate medical, dental or specialty-specific academic qualification and the prescribed teaching/research experience. The exact requirements vary by department. For relevant medical posts, candidates must satisfy the applicable professional registration requirements of the Medical Council or State Medical Council. Recognized postgraduate qualifications and valid experience are essential.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Assistant Professor Teaching Experience 2026
content_sections.text: Experience must ordinarily be in the concerned specialty as a Senior Resident, Tutor, Demonstrator or Registrar in a recognized teaching institution. Important: Teaching experience as a General Duty Medical Officer or Medical Officer will not be considered eligible teaching experience for these posts. Applicants holding DNB qualifications may need additional teaching experience according to the applicable Medical Council norms.

content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for Assistant Professor recruitment is 40 years . Applicants must meet the age, educational qualification and experience requirements as on the applicable closing date of online applications.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Assistant Professor Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive salaries under the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix . The initial basic pay figures correspond to the applicable standard 7th CPC pay matrices. Allowances are payable according to the relevant rules. Eligible medical and dental practitioners registered with the Medical Council of India or State Medical/Dental Councils may receive Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) at the rates determined by the Government of India. Salary Clarification: These figures represent initial basic pay and are not guaranteed take-home salary. The actual monthly amount depends on allowances, eligibility for NPA and deductions.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment Mode: Online. Application fees are non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate applications and pay separate fees where applicable.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications, shortlisting of eligible candidates and an interview. Online application submission. Verification of submitted qualifications and experience information. Scrutiny of eligibility and supporting documents. Shortlisting of eligible candidates. Interview for shortlisted candidates. Verification of original certificates and supporting documents. Final selection according to applicable college and university rules. No travelling allowance or daily allowance will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must complete their online application through the official UCMS recruitment facility. Official Website: www.ucms.ac.in Delhi University Website: www.du.ac.in Candidates should visit the Careers section of UCMS or the Jobs and Opportunities section under Work with DU to access the recruitment notification and online application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for UCMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Applicants must provide complete and correct information. Incomplete applications or applications without the required supporting documents may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for UCMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Annexure-I of the original notification lists the documents that candidates must attach to their online application. Proof of date of birth - Class 10 certificate. SC/ST/OBC/EWS category certificate, where applicable. PwBD certificate, where applicable. Bachelor's degree certificate and marksheets of all professional examinations. Master's/postgraduate degree certificate and marksheets. Ph.D. award certificate, wherever applicable. Teaching or other prescribed experience certificates. No Objection Certificate from the current employer, if applicable. Proof of the best five published research papers. List of publications. List of conferences attended. List of professional memberships. MCI/DCI/State Medical Council registration, as applicable. Proof of payment of application fee. Other relevant supporting certificates. Shortlisted candidates must bring original documents, a valid photo identity document and one set of self-attested photocopies when attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: UCMS Recruitment 2026 Reservation and Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities is governed by applicable UGC and Central Government rules. Candidates must upload valid, digitally verifiable reservation certificates in the prescribed Government of India format. OBC-NCL certificates must satisfy the current financial year's requirements and correspond to communities included in the Central List of Other Backward Classes. For PwBD reservation, candidates must possess a valid certificate showing at least 40% benchmark disability . Important: The advertised PwBD vacancies are specified for the Locomotor Disability category under the notification, including the disability conditions described in the original vacancy table.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the University College of Medical Sciences (UCMS) located in Delhi for filling various teaching faculty positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 54 vacancies announced for the position of Assistant Professor across multiple medical and dental departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the online application form is 28 November 2026. Candidates must complete submissions prior to this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a post-graduate degree such as MD, MS, DNB, M.Sc., or MDS in the respective specialty along with required teaching and research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is not exceeding 40 years as on the closing date of submission of the online application, with applicable relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UR/OBC/EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for UR, OBC, and EWS category applicants is Rs. 2,000/-, payable online during the application process.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC, ST, and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for SC, ST, PwBD, and women candidates as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the shortlisting of eligible candidates based on qualifications, followed by a formal interview.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official college website at www.ucms.ac.in, filling out the application form, and uploading all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted at the University College of Medical Sciences located in Dilshad Garden, Delhi - 110095.
